scripts.dev: npm run assets && concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @goc/server" "npm run dev -w @goc/client"
scripts.build: npm run assets && npm run build -w @goc/client
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/engine && tsc -p packages/shared && tsc -p packages/server && tsc -p packages/client
